verdict.rationale: Orb documents ASC606 revenue recognition tracking and 'exports for financial systems' plus managed daily exports to a chosen data destination, which could feed a GL, but no evidence names direct QuickBooks, Xero, or NetSuite connectors or a native ERP sync — it relies on generic export/webhook plumbing rather than turnkey accounting integrations. Missing for 10: named QuickBooks/Xero/NetSuite integrations, evidence of automated invoice/payment/recognition entry sync (not just data export), and any hands-on confirmation that close doesn't require manual reconciliation.
